issues.description: Function ray_sphere_intersect has inconsistent parameter lists across template files: the template header (example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h) declares ray_sphere_intersect with three parameters (const float *origin, const float *dir, const float *center), while the template implementation (example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.cpp) and the solution header (solution_repository/example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h) define/declare a fourth parameter (float radius). The example program's main (example_program/src/main.cpp) calls ray_sphere_intersect with four arguments (origin_f, dirn, center, radius2). This mismatch between header and implementation will cause compilation or linkage errors and prevents students from building/running the provided example program.
